requirements.case: Broken diag/ramme financial layout and changed postscript route
requirements.requirement: Preserve the literal broken account text and diag/ramme markers as extraction artifacts; no substantive HTML table or figure survives for P3-P5. Keep P11 as a verbal-answer request through Frank and P12 as a later postal-return request, without inventing a new date or completed Stokes authorization.

Please read the first paragraph & send me a verbal answer by Frank.—
I wrote this, when I thought Frank was going up tomorrow; will you send me a line by return of Post—to first paragraph; I suppose the money will be ready on Wednesday next.—

exact_source_evidence.normalized_quote: I am sorry to say there is one other business question, I must ask. In 16 th of Nov. 1835, your Father made over to me 518£ Debentures in Monmouth Canal, which pays now only 3 1/2 percent, so that I want to call it in, but Langton tells me, I ought to know whether the sum was lent for definite term.

requirements.case: Separate letter, specimens, plate and paper states
requirements.requirement: Keep the earlier 29 July letter, specimens received on 1 September, Lithotrya plate already seen, and offered paper still requested as distinct states. Preserve the author’s Angelin spelling in body text and separate editorial correction. Do not turn a requested paper into proof of reading.

normalized_quotes: I have delayed thus long to thank you for your letter of the 29th of July, in order to be able to tell you of the safe arrival of the specimens; they came to me this morning perfectly safe
I shd be very grateful for the Paper which you kindly offered to send me on the Lithotrya from the Nicobar islands; of which the Plate interested me much.
